component: Opt-in host-available floor for serving admission
status: implemented, default off; not qualified, not selected, not observed-used in serving

source.license: Apache-2.0; repository NOTICE applies to copied MTPLX code
source.used: The release's host-available memory guard and all-request pricing motivated an mlx2-specific optional floor. No MTPLX code was copied.

modifications: Keep existing lane, warm-copy, prefill-transient, output-length, Metal-advisory and physical-footprint pricing.
Cap final measured headroom after service-reserve credit by host-available bytes minus the configured floor, at every request admission read.
Use the existing default-off Mach host-memory-signals policy and ordinary memory-admission deferral. Active lanes and between-chunk execution are unchanged.
validation: Focused CPU tests in tests/test_host_memory_signals.py; no GPU or live-model qualification.
